title: jarava humilis var. ruiziana
intro: Jarava humilis var. ruiziana, commonly known as Andean knotgrass, is a plant species native to the Andean regions of South America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Andean knotgrass include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and soothe gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
